# Respire

> Respire is a local-first memory layer for AI tools. It keeps context, preferences and decisions on your device, with optional encrypted synchronization.

## Product

- [Respire overview](https://rsrs.rs/): Explains the local memory layer, supported workflows, privacy boundaries and plugin integrations.
- [Download Respire](https://rsrs.rs/download/): Desktop downloads for macOS, Windows and Linux, including platform requirements and checksums.
- [CLI repository](https://github.com/risense-ai/respire-cli): Source, releases and installation for the rsrs command-line interface.

## Documentation

- [Documentation overview](https://docs.rsrs.rs/): Components, architecture and links to user and developer guides.
- [Getting started](https://docs.rsrs.rs/getting-started): Install the desktop client or CLI, connect the Runtime and create a memory.
- [AI tool plugins](https://docs.rsrs.rs/plugins/): Installation, configuration and troubleshooting for supported AI hosts.
- [CLI commands](https://docs.rsrs.rs/cli): Command-line workflows for memory, synchronization and administration.
- [Architecture](https://docs.rsrs.rs/architecture): Local storage, retrieval, encryption and synchronization design.
- [Frequently asked questions](https://docs.rsrs.rs/faq): Answers about security, models, accounts, injection and compatibility.
- [Product FAQ](https://rsrs.rs/#faq): What Respire is, where memory lives, access scope and how to start.

## Plugins

- [Plugin guides](https://docs.rsrs.rs/plugins/): All 13 supported hosts, installation paths and Stop contracts.
- [ZCode](https://docs.rsrs.rs/plugins/zcode): Marketplace plugin with recall, prefix storage and a Stop storage check.
- [Kimi Code](https://docs.rsrs.rs/plugins/kimi): Hooks with per-turn recall and prefix storage.
- [Dim](https://docs.rsrs.rs/plugins/dimcode): Marketplace plugin with session rules and storage checks.
- [Qoder](https://docs.rsrs.rs/plugins/qoder): Hooks with recall, storage and a closing check.
- [WorkBuddy](https://docs.rsrs.rs/plugins/workbuddy): Plugin with session rules and bounded reminders.
- [Hermes](https://docs.rsrs.rs/plugins/hermes): Directory memory provider for Hermes Agent.
- [Codex](https://docs.rsrs.rs/plugins/codex): Native plugin with recall, explicit store and Stop reminders.
- [Pi](https://docs.rsrs.rs/plugins/pi): Native extension with recall and end-of-turn review.
- [DSH](https://docs.rsrs.rs/plugins/dsh): Native memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness.
- [Magpie](https://docs.rsrs.rs/plugins/magpie): Connects Magpie to the local Runtime and archives completed turns.
- [OpenClaw](https://docs.rsrs.rs/plugins/openclaw): Plugin with recall, prefix storage and session hooks.
- [MiniMax Code](https://docs.rsrs.rs/plugins/minimax-code): Plugin with a skill, MCP server and lifecycle hooks.
- [General](https://docs.rsrs.rs/plugins/general): Portable Agent Plugins 1.0 package with a skill and MCP server.

## Chinese

- [中文首页](https://rsrs.rs/zh/): Respire 的中文产品介绍、插件与下载入口。

- [中文文档](https://docs.rsrs.rs/zh/): Respire 的中文产品文档、安装指南、接口说明与架构资料。
- [中文插件指南](https://docs.rsrs.rs/zh/plugins/): 各 AI 宿主的安装、配置与故障排查。
